collection.title: Career Roadmaps & Skill Milestones
collection.description: Comprehensive skill progressions, milestone roadmaps, and salary benchmarks for engineering careers.
collection.scopeLabel: 2 Tech & Science Career Roadmaps with Industry Milestones

items.subject: Machine Learning & AI
items.body: **Machine Learning Engineer Milestone Tree**: Stage 1: Linear algebra, calculus, probability & PyTorch; Stage 2: Classical ML (Scikit-Learn, XGBoost) & Deep Learning architectures; Stage 3: LLMs, Fine-tuning, Quantization, vLLM; Stage 4: Production MLOps (Docker, CI/CD, Triton, Kubernetes).

items.subject: Software Engineering
items.body: **Fullstack Cloud-Native Developer Tree**: Stage 1: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js; Stage 2: Relational (PostgreSQL) & NoSQL databases with indexing & sharding; Stage 3: Distributed messaging (Kafka, Redis), Docker & AWS; Stage 4: High-throughput API gateway & microservices design.
